title: Bounded filtered constructible derived category
statement: Let $X$ be a separated finite-type scheme over the algebraic closure $k$ of a finite field and let $A=A_{E,n}$ be the finite constant coefficient ring of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Work in the abelian category of $A_X$-module sheaves on the small pro-étale site specified there. A bounded filtered complex is a bounded cochain complex $M$ with a finite decreasing filtration by subcomplexes $F^pM$, equal to $M$ for sufficiently small $p$ and zero for sufficiently large $p$. Put $\operatorname{gr}^pM=F^pM/F^{p+1}M$. The bounded filtered derived category $D^bF(X,A)$ is the localization of bounded filtered complexes and filtration-preserving chain maps at maps inducing quasi-isomorphisms on every graded piece; localization means formally inverting those maps. Write $\omega$ for forgetting the filtration and $\operatorname{gr}^p$ for the graded-piece functors. Filtration truncation $t^{\ge p}$ retains the subcomplex $F^pM$ with its induced filtration; $t^{\le p}$ takes the quotient by $F^{p+1}M$, with its quotient filtration, and $t^{<p}=t^{\le p-1}$. The full subcategory $D^bF_{ctf}(X,A)$ consists of objects with every graded piece in $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Superscripts $[a,b]$ restrict to grades $a\le p\le b$. The same filtered construction for complexes of abelian groups is denoted $DF(\mathbf{Ab})$, without a bound on cochain degrees and with finite filtration. An ordinary complex can be placed in filtration degree zero, by $F^pM=M$ for $p\le0$ and $F^pM=0$ for $p>0$.
